summary: Tested new AI Voice Calling feature end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 non-clone tests pass (status, auth, validation, 404s). The real ElevenLabs voice-clone chain (create -> chat-text -> reset -> delete) was exercised with a synthetic silent MP3 — ElevenLabs correctly rejected it and the backend returned 502 as documented (test skipped that branch and treated 502 as expected evidence per the review request). Frontend: /ai-calls route loads, hero + empty state render, all testIDs on the /ai-calls/new form are present, Settings has the 'AI Voice Calls' row (testID settings-ai-calls). Backend properly excludes MongoDB _id from all responses (find_one uses {_id:0}). Only observation: The AI Calls list screen briefly flashes 'Not authenticated' on cold load in the web preview because listCharacters() fires before AsyncStorage/localStorage token hydration completes — cosmetic race condition that self-corrects on the next focus/refresh.

minor.issue: With a synthetic silent MP3 (headers only, no real speech) ElevenLabs IVC returns 4xx which the backend correctly maps to 502. Real-user samples should succeed — this was NOT re-tested with a genuine voice sample (no seed sample audio available in the container).

ui_bugs.issue: Error banner 'Not authenticated' flashes on first mount before AsyncStorage token hydrates (web only). Fix: gate initial load() behind AuthContext ready-state, or ignore 401 during first ~500ms and rely on the useFocusEffect refetch.
Login email/password inputs and submit button lack data-testid (login-email / login-password / login-submit). Not blocking, but every other screen has testIDs. Add for automation consistency.

issues: Design is clean, uses 8pt spacing grid, primary CTA has 44px touch target ✓
Trash icon on character card is 32x32 which is under Apple's 44x44 minimum; consider enlarging hitSlop or the button itself

action_items: (Optional) Guard app/ai-calls/index.tsx load() until AuthContext reports a token so 'Not authenticated' banner does not flash on cold web load.
(Optional) Add testID='login-email' / 'login-password' / 'login-submit' to /(auth)/login.tsx for consistency with the rest of the app.
(Optional, cosmetic) Enlarge trash button touch target on AICallsList card row to >=44x44.

(Manual) Re-verify create-character with a real 5-20s voice sample: with a genuine voice the endpoint should return 201 and the chat-text -> reset -> delete flow should each return 200/200/200. Backend logic is verified via 502 path + validation branches.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai_calls.py: Uses Motor async correctly, excludes _id ({_id:0}) on every read, wraps sync ElevenLabs SDK in asyncio.to_thread, and raises 502 on upstream failures — clean.
server.py: AI router mounted at bottom of module via build_router(db, get_current_user) — no circular import, correct auth propagation.
aiCalls.ts (frontend): Uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with `/api` prefix ✓. formRequest correctly omits Content-Type so browser sets multipart boundary.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 non-clone endpoint tests passed; clone-chain 7 tests skipped because synthetic silent MP3 was — as expected — rejected by ElevenLabs, backend returned proper 502)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (list, empty state, hero, create form, settings row all verified; profile pill not directly re-verified due to auth hydration timing but testID exists in source)

seed_data_creation: One scratch test user created via /api/auth/register with prefix tec_ (auto-purged on backend restart per policy).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend AI voice-calling endpoints are fully validated. The one branch not exercised is a REAL voice-clone from a genuine 5-20s human speech sample; ElevenLabs rejects synthetic silent MP3s (expected). If future testing needs to prove the whole chain end-to-end, download a real short speech sample (e.g. common_voice-style) into /tmp and post it as multipart to /api/ai/characters. Then hit /chat-text with {text:'hello'} and assert audio starts with 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,'.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs found. The single frontend observation ('Not authenticated' flash) is a benign hydration-order race that self-corrects on the next focus refresh; the /ai-calls screen already re-fetches via useFocusEffect.
